mainEntity.name: What is the most important factor in mortgage affordability?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important factor is your stable monthly cash flow after essential expenses. Interest rate and tenure matter, but cash flow resilience determines long-term affordability.

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a longer tenure to reduce EMI?

acceptedAnswer.text: A longer tenure lowers monthly payment but increases total interest. Choose the shortest tenure you can comfortably manage without harming savings and emergency reserves.

mainEntity.name: How can I reduce total mortgage interest?

acceptedAnswer.text: Increase down payment, improve credit profile, negotiate a lower rate, and make early prepayments on principal.

mainEntity.name: Is the mortgage formula same in India, USA, and UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: The reducing-balance mortgage formula is generally the same, but lender policies, fees, taxes, and product structures differ across countries.

mainEntity.name: Does this calculator include property tax and insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: This calculator focuses on principal and interest estimates. Property tax, insurance, and local charges should be added separately.
